cases.case_label: De novo L1 insertion in F8 (patient JH-27)
cases.mechanism_detail: Previously reported de novo L1 insertion (3785 bp) in the factor VIII gene of a hemophilia A patient, re-sequenced here to show an intact ORF; location and molecular consequence are not described in the abstract.
cases.quote: We have sequenced this insertion and two previously reported de novo L1 insertions in the factor VIII gene in patients JH-27 (3785 bp) and JH-28 (2132 bp).
